question: Which district has the higher population density in 2025, Brightwater or Millbrook, and by how many residents per square kilometre?
answer:
Millbrook has the higher population density by 0.6 residents per square kilometre.

ANSWER: Millbrook | 0.6

matches.text: Brightwater has 17 schools, which enrolled 6,241 pupils for the 2025/26 school year. matches.title: Tarnvale district profile (2025)
matches.text: Tarnvale lies on the Tarn and was founded in 1854. The 2025 census counted 71,388 residents, up from 67,214 at the 2020 census, on an area of 2,106.9 square kilometres.
